panels.description: Where the chain tip sits in the current epoch (slots since the epoch started), against the wall-clock slot (gray dashed reference). The vertical distance between the two lines is the tip gap: how many slots the tip trails the wall clock, the same quantity the Tip Gap panel below charts from dingo_tip_gap_slots. Blocks arrive about every 20 slots, so a healthy node trails by a few tens of slots, too small to see at this scale. A visible gap means the node is behind: syncing, stalled, or just restarted. At an epoch boundary the reference drops to 0 a moment before the tip crosses into the new epoch.
panels.title: Slot In Epoch
Chain Progress
panels.description: Blocks applied to the ledger per minute (10m rate), against the protocol average of 3/min (active slot coefficient 0.05 at one slot per second). Sustained dips below the line mean the node is falling behind or the network is producing fewer blocks.

tip gap: wall-clock slot minus applied tip, updated every slot; mainnet averages ~20 between blocks. forge gap: chain-selection tip minus applied tip at each leader check; should be 0, and anything above it means a forged block would build on a stale parent. A spike in sync skips may indicate transient network issues.
panels.title: Tip Gap, Forge Gap & Sync Skips
Chain Switches & Forks
panels.description: Chain selection switching to a different peer's chain, and forks (rollbacks) applied, per minute.

panels.title: Ledger Pipeline
panels.description: Pipeline halted (unrepairable validation failure) and stuck (restarting without tip progress) are 0/1 flags; restarts counts restarts that made no tip progress.

panels.title: Chain Selection & Rollbacks
panels.description: Chain selection stalls in 15m by reason, and unrecoverable rollbacks in 1h (the local chain diverged from peers beyond the rollback limit).

panels.title: Chain Density
panels.description: Fraction of slots holding a block over the recent window. Mainnet targets 5% (active slot coefficient); the header warns below 4% and goes critical below 3%.

panels.title: Rewards & Snapshots
panels.description: Epoch reward rounds skipped since start (balances are then wrong) and stake snapshot capture failures in 24h.

panels.title: Block Composition by Era
panels.description: Applied block and transaction rate by era. An era transition or a run of transaction-heavy blocks shows up here before it shows up as SQL load.

panels.title: Script & Redeemer Activity
panels.description: Rate of blocks carrying at least one Plutus V1/V2/V3 script or redeemer, and the finer-grained redeemer count itself -- a run of script-heavy blocks is one of the more expensive causes of a SQL query-volume spike.

panels.title: UTxO Churn & Certificates
panels.description: UTxO creation/consumption (from each transaction's Produced()/Consumed(), correct for phase-2-failed transactions) and certificate rate by era -- both known query-heavy paths.
